name: Milf's Tale
source:
You are going to help Alice, who is already 34 years old and raised a daughter on her own, but has no work experience and poor social skills. It is up to you whether Alice will find a well-paid job and a loved one or will break bad and start living for the moment. Don't forget about her daughter Chloe, who needs her mother's support after recently turning 18. You can't control her directly, but your conversations will affect her life in various ways.

[Edited from Patreon]
translation:
你要帮助Alice，她已经34岁了，独自抚养一个女儿，但没有工作经验，社交能力也很差。爱丽丝是否会找到一份高薪工作和一个所爱的人，或者会破产并开始暂时的生活，这取决于你。别忘了她的女儿Chloe，她刚刚满18岁，需要母亲的支持。你无法直接控制她，但你的谈话会以各种方式影响她的生活。

[编辑自Patreon]
